name: mdh-fuzzy-score-normalization
summary: Fuzzy name search with length-ratio score normalization to penalize length mismatch.

threshold.description: normalized score floor (0-1); bounded ~0.5 at raw~1, so default is permissive — calibrate, see README

notes: Normalized score is bounded by x/(1+x) (~0.5 at raw~1); the default floor is permissive — calibrate per collection. This fragment is the query half of a MatchConfig only — it writes nothing until you add the mapping/result_actions block that lands the matched row on your schema fields, which is why produces is empty.
